section_summary: This section covers diplomatic exchanges and technical reports from April 1940 to January 1941 concerning international radio interference affecting U.S. services. Matters addressed include Japanese vessel interference with U.S. Navy direction finding, interference from East Asian transmitters with General Electric station KGEI broadcasts and listener responses, harmonic interference from Japanese stations JDK, JND, and JZP affecting Press Wireless and naval communications, and diplomatic protests regarding the temporary disbarment of CBS correspondent W. R. Wills in Tokyo.

subfiles.about: Page two of Tokyo Embassy despatch No. 4607 reporting on Japanese vessel radio interference.
subfiles.summary: Embassy confirms transmittal of interference complaints to Japanese authorities and promises continued monitoring.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 4607 (Page 2) regarding Japanese Inter-Ship Radio Interference

subfiles.about: Japanese Foreign Office interim reply acknowledging representations regarding radio interference.
subfiles.summary: Ad interim reply stating representations on California naval direction finding interference were sent to authorities.
subfiles.title: Note Verbale No. 47 on Direction Finding Service Interference

subfiles.about: Transmittal of Tokyo Embassy despatch No. 4607 to the Secretary of the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Tokyo Embassy report regarding Japanese ship interference with naval direction finding on 375 kilocycles.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Secretary of the Navy

subfiles.about: Despatch transmitting Japanese Foreign Office reply on shipboard radio interference.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Foreign Office note stating relevant parties and offending ships were notified to prevent interference.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 4656 on Direction Finding Interference Reply

subfiles.about: Japanese Foreign Office note detailing measures taken with specific vessels.
subfiles.summary: States notices were issued to concerned parties and special attention directed to Eiyo Maru and Kaijo Maru.
subfiles.title: Note Verbale No. 68 on Vessel Radio Interference

subfiles.about: Transmittal of Tokyo Embassy despatch No. 4656 to Secretary of the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Tokyo Embassy despatch regarding Japanese vessel interference with naval direction finding communications.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Secretary of the Navy

subfiles.about: Commerce Department letter regarding interference with shortwave broadcasts from station KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Reports GE and FCC responses concerning frequency adjustments to eliminate interference with station KGEI broadcasts.
subfiles.title: Letter regarding Interference with Station KGEI Broadcasts

subfiles.about: Duplicate copy of Commerce Department letter regarding KGEI broadcast interference.
subfiles.summary: Carbon copy of letter concerning FCC and GE actions on KGEI interference.
subfiles.title: Duplicate Copy of Letter regarding Station KGEI Broadcasts

subfiles.about: Reference slip concerning communications from the Electrical Division.
subfiles.summary: Reference slip regarding communications from the Electrical Division of the Department of Commerce.
subfiles.title: Reference Slip on Electrical Division Communications

subfiles.about: Report on shortwave interference affecting station KGEI broadcasts across the Orient.
subfiles.summary: Details persistent shortwave interference with KGEI broadcasts from stations in Japan, Hong Kong, and Batavia, discussing engineering observations and crystal control.
subfiles.title: Report on Interference with Broadcast Programs from Station KGEI

subfiles.about: State Department acknowledgement of Commerce communication regarding KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges Commerce letter and notes information was transmitted to the Shanghai Consulate General.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Secretary of Commerce

subfiles.about: Instruction to Shanghai Consul regarding steps taken on KGEI interference.
subfiles.summary: Informs Consul Butrick of GE and FCC efforts to reassign frequencies and eliminate KGEI interference.
subfiles.title: Instruction to American Consul at Shanghai

subfiles.about: Embassy telegram reporting Japanese Foreign Office response on station JND interference.
subfiles.summary: Reports Japanese reply claiming JND frequency stability and directional beam to Europe, requesting compliance with Cairo regulations.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 335 from Tokyo regarding Station JND Interference

subfiles.about: Transmittal of Tokyo telegram regarding station JND to Secretary of the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Tokyo telegram regarding Japanese station JND interference with naval station NSS for Navy comment.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Secretary of the Navy

subfiles.about: Internal State Department routing note regarding pending service response.
subfiles.summary: Notes that answer to service on attached communication has not yet been received.
subfiles.title: Memorandum from M. Tallant to Mr. Offterman

subfiles.about: Tokyo telegram transmitting Foreign Office technical calculations regarding station JDK.
subfiles.summary: Reports Japanese Foreign Office technical findings that JDK second harmonic field strength at Manila cannot cause interference with station KJY.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 403 from Tokyo regarding Station JDK Interference

subfiles.about: Letter transmitting Tokyo Embassy findings on JDK harmonic interference to FCC.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Tokyo telegram quoting Japanese claims regarding station JDK and inquires if recent complaints were received.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Chairman, FCC

subfiles.about: FCC acknowledgement regarding station JDK interference in Manila.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges State Department letter and confirms no interference with KJY reception was reported recently.
subfiles.title: Letter from FCC Chairman to Secretary of State

subfiles.about: Internal routing slip requesting indexing and return of document.
subfiles.summary: Requests indexing and return of attached file with previous correspondence.
subfiles.title: Routing Slip from Francis Colt de Wolf to DCR

subfiles.about: General Electric letter forwarding listener reports praising KGEI news broadcasts.
subfiles.summary: Transmits listener letters commending KGEI shortwave news broadcasts and war reporting in the Pacific and Far East.
subfiles.title: Letter from General Electric Company to Breckinridge Long

subfiles.about: Listener letter commending KGEI early morning news received in Singapore.
subfiles.summary: Praises clear reception of KGEI news programs in Singapore and requests exposition literature.
subfiles.title: Letter from Tin Nan Club to Station KGEI

subfiles.about: Shipboard radio officer letter reporting KGEI reception in Africa and Cape Verde.
subfiles.summary: Reports listeners along South Africa and Cape Verde rely on KGEI news broadcasts for unbiased wartime reporting.
subfiles.title: Letter from Carl W. Lundquist to Station KGEI

subfiles.about: Listener letter commending KGEI reception and objective news reporting in Guizhou.
subfiles.summary: Appreciates clear KGEI broadcasts in Kweiyang, China, noting the valuable educational disclosure of censorship and propaganda.
subfiles.title: Letter from YWCA Kweiyang to Station KGEI

subfiles.about: Listener letter requesting exposition materials and praising KGEI reception in Tientsin.
subfiles.summary: Expresses appreciation for clear evening broadcasts in Tientsin and requests exposition pamphlet and time chart.
subfiles.title: Letter from W. Morgan to Station KGEI

subfiles.about: Listener letter regarding KGEI broadcast reception in Durban, South Africa.
subfiles.summary: Brief note expressing appreciation for reception of KGEI broadcasts in Durban, South Africa.
subfiles.title: Letter from Durban Listener to Station KGEI

subfiles.about: Listener letter commending KGEI European war news reception in Manila.
subfiles.summary: Commends clear Manila reception of European war news overpowering Hong Kong and Japanese stations.
subfiles.title: Letter from W. K. Lemon to Station KGEI

subfiles.about: Missionary letter expressing appreciation for KGEI news broadcasts in Chekiang.
subfiles.summary: Praises comfort provided by news broadcasts in Lishui, noting reduction of interference from Japanese and Hong Kong stations.
subfiles.title: Letter from Rev. Vincent Morrison to General Electric Company

subfiles.about: State Department acknowledgement to GE regarding listener reception of KGEI.
subfiles.summary: Expresses satisfaction with reports of reduced interference and notes Ambassador's request for more American news.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to R. L. Gibson

subfiles.about: Tokyo Embassy despatch transmitting Japanese Foreign Office note on station JND.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Japanese Foreign Office note verbale regarding interference between station JND and naval station NSS.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 4748 on Japanese Station JND Interference

subfiles.about: Japanese Foreign Office note detailing technical parameters of station JND.
subfiles.summary: Asserts JND operates within Cairo regulations with beam directed towards Europe, requesting adherence to Article 22 notification procedures.
subfiles.title: Note Verbale No. 102 regarding Station JND Interference

subfiles.about: Transmittal of Tokyo despatch No. 4748 to the Acting Secretary of the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Tokyo Embassy report regarding Japanese station JND interference with naval station NSS.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Acting Secretary of the Navy

subfiles.about: Tokyo Embassy despatch transmitting Foreign Office technical note on station JDK.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Japanese note verbale and technical summary by Naval Attaché regarding station JDK harmonic calculations.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 4749 on Japanese Station JDK Interference

subfiles.about: Japanese Foreign Minister's note transmitting technical reply regarding station JDK.
subfiles.summary: Transmits calculations asserting second harmonic field strength of JDK in Manila is insufficient to cause interference.
subfiles.title: Note No. 105 from Foreign Minister Hachiro Arita

subfiles.about: State Department transmittal of Tokyo despatch No. 4749 to Chairman, FCC.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Tokyo Embassy despatch transmitting Japanese technical report on station JDK interference with station KJY.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Chairman, FCC

subfiles.about: FCC complaint regarding Japanese station JZP interference with Press Wireless station WJS.
subfiles.summary: Requests diplomatic representations regarding station JZP scrambled speech interference with WJS on 15,700 kilocycles citing prior registration.
subfiles.title: Letter from FCC Chairman to Secretary of State

subfiles.about: Telegraphic instruction to Tokyo Embassy to protest station JZP interference.
subfiles.summary: Instructs Embassy to request immediate cessation of station JZP interference with Press Wireless station WJS.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 404 to American Embassy Tokyo

subfiles.about: Notification to FCC of telegraphic instructions sent to Tokyo regarding station JZP.
subfiles.summary: Informs FCC that telegraphic instructions were dispatched to Tokyo Embassy regarding station JZP interference.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Chairman, FCC

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet recording transfer of document 894.74/258.
subfiles.summary: Records transfer of file 894.74/258 to 856D.6363/781 1/2.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for File 894.74/258

subfiles.about: Tokyo telegram reporting informal Foreign Office statement that JZP tests ended.
subfiles.summary: Reports Japanese statement that accidental use of frequency during South Pacific communications tests had voluntarily ceased.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 1046 from Tokyo regarding Station JZP

subfiles.about: Letter forwarding Tokyo telegram regarding cessation of JZP interference to FCC.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Tokyo telegram and requests confirmation whether interference with station WJS has in fact ceased.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Chairman, FCC

subfiles.about: Internal routing slip requesting attachment of previous correspondence.
subfiles.summary: Instructs Division of Communications and Records to attach relevant previous papers.
subfiles.title: Routing Slip from Francis Colt de Wolf to DCR

subfiles.about: FCC report that Japanese station JZP interference with station WJS is continuing daily.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Press Wireless log showing daily continuing interference from station JZP between October 22 and 31.
subfiles.title: Letter from FCC Chairman to Secretary of State

subfiles.about: Tokyo telegram transmitting Foreign Office confirmation that interference was eliminated.
subfiles.summary: Reports Japanese Foreign Office note verbale claiming cause of interference was eliminated from October 23.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 1120 from Tokyo regarding Station WJS

subfiles.about: Duplicate copy of State Department letter to FCC regarding Tokyo telegram.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate copy of letter inquiring whether station JZP interference has ceased.
subfiles.title: Duplicate Copy of Letter to Chairman, FCC

subfiles.about: Telegraphic instruction to Tokyo Embassy to renew representations on continuing JZP interference.
subfiles.summary: Provides daily schedule of continuing interference and instructs Embassy to request immediate remedial action.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 484 to American Embassy Tokyo

subfiles.about: State Department notification to FCC of renewed instructions to Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: Informs FCC that data on continuing interference was telegraphed to Tokyo Embassy for further representations.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Chairman, FCC

subfiles.about: File copy of Tokyo telegram No. 1120 regarding Foreign Office note verbale.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate file copy of telegram reporting Japanese claim that interference was eliminated from October 23.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 1120 (Record Copy) from Tokyo

subfiles.about: Letter forwarding Tokyo telegram No. 1120 to FCC Chairman.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Tokyo telegram reporting Japanese claim that WJS interference ceased on October 23.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Chairman, FCC

subfiles.about: Tokyo Embassy despatch transmitting note verbale representations regarding station JZ.
subfiles.summary: Transmits note verbale No. 1658 requesting Japanese authorities put an end to interference with station WJS.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 5085 on Interference with Station WJS

subfiles.about: Tokyo Embassy note verbale requesting cessation of interference with station WJS.
subfiles.summary: Urges elimination of interference with station WJS citing priority of U.S. registration under Bern Bureau list.
subfiles.title: Note Verbale No. 1658 regarding Station WJS Interference

subfiles.about: State Department letter to FCC transmitting Tokyo despatch No. 5085 and noting call letter error.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Tokyo despatch and notes Embassy was advised that call letters are JZP rather than JZ.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Chairman, FCC

subfiles.about: Telegraphic instruction to Tokyo Embassy correcting call letters to JZP.
subfiles.summary: Corrects call letters of interfering station from JZ to JZP.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 511 to American Embassy Tokyo

subfiles.about: Tokyo telegram clarifying that designation error resulted from Department telegraphic garble.
subfiles.summary: Explains incorrect call letters arose from telegraphic garble and notes Japanese reply correctly identifies station as JZP.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 1256 from Tokyo regarding Call Letters

subfiles.about: File copy of telegraphic instruction No. 511 correcting station call letters.
subfiles.summary: Record copy of telegram advising Embassy that interfering station call letters are JZP.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 511 (Record Copy) to Tokyo

subfiles.about: State Department note forwarding Tokyo telegram No. 1256 to FCC.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Tokyo telegram regarding station call letter clarification to FCC Chairman.
subfiles.title: Note from State Department to Chairman, FCC

subfiles.about: Tokyo Embassy despatch transmitting Japanese notes on cessation of JZP interference.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Foreign Office note explaining JZP interference was caused by temporary South Seas tests which ceased October 23.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 5134 on Station JZP Interference

subfiles.about: Japanese Foreign Office note and Ministry communication regarding station JZP test transmissions.
subfiles.summary: Explains 15,700 kc is normally used with Dairen, and temporary South Seas testing was stopped October 23 following wireless notice.
subfiles.title: Note Verbale No. 174 on Station JZP Interference

subfiles.about: State Department letter transmitting Tokyo despatch No. 5134 to FCC.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Tokyo despatch and Japanese communications explaining station JZP testing and cessation.
subfiles.title: Letter from State Department to Chairman, FCC

subfiles.about: Tokyo Embassy despatch transmitting note verbale No. 1692 on continued WJS interference.
subfiles.summary: Transmits note verbale presenting FCC log of continuing daily interference from October 22 to 31.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 5170 on Continued Station WJS Interference

subfiles.about: Tokyo Embassy note verbale detailing continued interference log with station WJS.
subfiles.summary: Presents schedule of daily interference through October 31 and requests immediate remedial action.
subfiles.title: Note Verbale No. 1692 regarding Continued WJS Interference

subfiles.about: State Department transmittal of Tokyo despatch No. 5170 to FCC.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Tokyo Embassy despatch No. 5170 regarding continuing interference with station WJS.
subfiles.title: Note from State Department to Chairman, FCC

subfiles.about: Tokyo Embassy despatch reporting successful diplomatic intervention regarding CBS correspondent W. R. Wills.
subfiles.summary: Reports successful oral representations to Foreign Minister removing broadcasting disbarment imposed by Broadcasting Corporation of Japan on CBS correspondent W. R. Wills.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 5211 on Disbarment of W. R. Wills from Broadcasting
